blocks.text: Amid speculations that their marriage is on the rocks, Baron Geisler and Jamie Evangelista were seen together again as they attended a couples’ retreat. The actor gave a glimpse of the event through his Facebook page last Friday, Oct. 16. In the caption, he wrote, “Marriage is not always easy. There will be seasons of joy and seasons of challenges, moments of understanding and moments when we struggle to understand each other.” “But love is more than a feeling.
